BiblicalUsage: The name is Ruth, a Moabitess. You find the name in Ruth 1:4, "…other Ruth: and they dwelled there about ten…", and again in Ruth 1:14 and Ruth 1:16.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Ruth is remembered because God keeps count of his own, name by name. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
